label: Chinese universities: international undergraduate application and review, 2027

milestones.label: Sit the CSCA before you apply
milestones.note: From 2026/2027, every applicant for a bachelor's degree in China must sit the CSCA before applying. Zhejiang's 2026 guide lists sittings in January, March, April, June and December.

milestones.label: University application windows
milestones.note: Each university publishes its own guide (招生简章). For 2026, Zhejiang ran 1 December 2025 to 28 February 2026, so expect windows to close before IB results. Tsinghua's dates are behind its application system's login.

submissionItems.label: HSK for Chinese-taught programmes; TOEFL or IELTS for English-taught ones
submissionItems.note: As in Zhejiang's 2026 guide. Most programmes are taught in Chinese.

supplementarySteps: Register for the CSCA at csca.cn early. Without a score you cannot apply.
Check which intake a date belongs to. Some programmes also take a spring intake.

notes: applicantGroup is non-eu because China's category is 'international student', meaning a non-Chinese citizen. EU status plays no part.
Only Zhejiang's guide (for 2026) was read. The 2027 guides for Tsinghua, Peking, Fudan, SJTU, Tongji and Sun Yat-sen were not read.
